lessons.title: Three known labels, one gentle order
lessons.gloss: place the three previously taught labels in a fixed form order

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach them, but leave these sections until you have stopped: Warm-up and Guided Practice — cover and point.

segments.text: Point to the three labels you have already written: ਉਮਰ:, ਫ਼ੋਨ:, ਤਾਰੀਖ਼:. No new field or value is added here.

This little fictional form puts age on the first line, phone on the second, and date on the third. Copy only the three labels in that order, with one empty space after each colon. Leave the values blank for now.
Cover the form. Point to three empty lines and say which known field belongs on each. Uncover it to check only the line order, not any digits.
Today only the labels and their places matter. The next step reunites the small closed banks already learned one at a time.

segments.prompt: Put the three familiar labels on lines 1, 2, and 3; leave values blank.

feedback.correct: The familiar fields are in the printed form order.
feedback.incorrect: Check line 1 age, line 2 phone, and line 3 date before adding values.

lessons.title: One card chooses three already-known values
lessons.gloss: choose a matching set from the three previously taught closed banks

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach it, but leave this section until you have stopped: Guided Practice — select before writing.

segments.text: The old closed banks are visible again. Age A is ੧੫, B is ੨੫. Phone A is ੦੧੨ ੨੫੧, B is ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫. Date A is ੧੫/੦੧/੨੦੨੫, B is ੨੫/੦੨/੨੦੨੫. These are fictional practice values, not personal data.

blocks.title: You'll want to know — a single shared cue

segments.text: On this practice card ਕ chooses A from each bank; ਖ chooses B from each bank. You already met these shapes in phone and date. For age, the card now points to its old A or B bank too. The card mark is never copied into a form field.
Point to ਕ. Point to the A value in each bank, top to bottom: age, phone, date. Do not write yet. Repeat for ਖ and its B values. Check selection before checking any digits.
The banks stay visible here. Selection is the only new step.

segments.prompt: The fictional card is ਖ. Which old bank letter is chosen for age, phone, and date, in that order?

feedback.correct: The one card selects B from each previously taught bank.
feedback.incorrect: Use the shared cue once: ਖ selects B for each field.

lessons.title: Fill the little form with the bank still open
lessons.gloss: copy one selected set of known fictional values into the three-line form

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: The card ਕ asks for A in each old bank. The three A values are visible: age ੧੫, phone ੦੧੨ ੨੫੧, date ੧੫/੦੧/੨੦੨੫.

blocks.title: Writing — one familiar line at a time

segments.text: For ਕ, copy the selected value after each printed label. Finish one line before moving to the next. Keep the phone's single group space and the date's two slash marks.
Compare the selected bank letter first, the value on each line second, and line order third. Correct one difference at a time. This supported copy does not count as independent writing.
The bank remains visible throughout this gentle supported attempt.

segments.prompt: With the bank visible, fill the fictional three-line form for ਕ.

feedback.correct: The visible A set is copied into the fixed order.
feedback.incorrect: Point to A in each old bank and copy one line at a time.

lessons.title: Hide the bank for one short turn
lessons.gloss: hide the taught value bank briefly and recover the three selected fictional fields

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
waitUntilStopped: Guided Practice — uncover only to compare
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach them, but leave these sections until you have stopped: Warm-up and Guided Practice — uncover only to compare.

segments.text: Read the familiar B set once: ਉਮਰ: ੨੫, ਫ਼ੋਨ: ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫, ਤਾਰੀਖ਼: ੨੫/੦੨/੨੦੨੫. Point to one line at a time.
Cover the model. Wait five seconds. The card is ਖ. Write the three lines in the known order, recalling one line at a time. Keep the model covered until all three lines are finished.

blocks.title: Guided Practice — uncover only to compare

segments.text: Uncover the model. Compare age first, phone second, and date third. This is still delayed-copy practice, not an independent checkpoint.
If one line was hard, revisit only that old field before continuing.

segments.prompt: After covering the model for five seconds, fill the three familiar fields for ਖ.

feedback.correct: The B set is recalled after a short delay in the fixed field order.
feedback.incorrect: Complete the attempt, uncover the model, and compare one line at a time.

lessons.title: Check the values in three little passes
lessons.gloss: repair selection, digit order, and date format as separate passes

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: The card ਖ still selects B for all three fictional fields. Before checking any digit, ask: did every line use B, not a mixture of A and B?

Make three separate passes. First check the selected bank letter for each line. Next check digits left to right, including the phone's group of three and three. Last check the date's day/month/year boxes and two slash marks. Do not erase a correct line to fix another one.

blocks.title: Guided Practice — one change at a time

segments.text: For ਖ, suppose the age line says ੧੫. Change only its selected value to ੨੫. If the phone line says ੦੨੫ ੧੫੨, keep the first group and repair only the last two digit positions. If the date says ੨੫/੦੨੨੦੨੫, keep all digits and add only the missing slash.
Label spelling, spacing, and placement get their own pass next.

segments.prompt: For ਖ, repair only the wrong digit order in ਫ਼ੋਨ: ੦੨੫ ੧੫੨.

feedback.correct: Only the phone's last two digit positions changed.
feedback.incorrect: Keep the first group and the label; check the known B phone digits left to right.

lessons.title: Check the labels and their places
lessons.gloss: repair label spelling, spaces, and line placement without changing correct values

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach it, but leave this section until you have stopped: Warm-up.

segments.text: Read the known labels once: ਉਮਰ:, ਫ਼ੋਨ:, ਤਾਰੀਖ਼:. The little dot marks in ਫ਼ and ਖ਼ belong to their spellings.

First compare label spelling; restore a missing dot without touching digits. Then compare spacing: one readable space follows each colon, and the phone has one group space. Finally compare placement: age is line one, phone line two, date line three. Move a whole correct value to its proper line; do not rewrite its digits.

blocks.title: Guided Practice — a single spelling repair

segments.text: In ਤਾਰੀਖ: ੨੫/੦੨/੨੦੨੫, fix only the label to ਤਾਰੀਖ਼. The date stays unchanged. In ਫੋਨ: ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫, fix only the label to ਫ਼ੋਨ.
You have now practised six distinct checks: choice, digit order, date format, label spelling, spacing, and placement. The final short attempt hides the value bank again.

segments.prompt: Repair only the label spelling in ਤਾਰੀਖ: ੨੫/੦੨/੨੦੨੫.

feedback.correct: The dot beneath ਖ was restored; the correct value stayed put.
feedback.incorrect: Keep every date digit and slash; repair only the label's final letter.

lessons.title: One no-model fictional three-field form
lessons.gloss: select and write three known fictional fields from one cue without a value model

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Close the earlier lessons. No value bank, support-language label, Latin-digit version, romanization, or copyable Gurmukhi value appears below.
Complete the fictional form for the one card mark. Use only the old known values. Write all three in Gurmukhi digits from memory. Do not reopen a lesson until all three lines are filled.

blocks.title: Guided Practice — repair after the attempt

segments.text: Only after writing, check six dimensions separately: selection, digit order, date format, label spelling, spacing, then field placement. Repair the first different dimension without erasing a correct one.
This closes only an untimed three-field checkpoint. The complete six-field form, timed writing, two full mocks, and human A1 validation remain separate dependency-linked work.

segments.prompt: With no value bank or copyable answer, complete all three fictional form fields for ਖ.

feedback.correct: One remembered cue selected all three taught values in the fixed order.
feedback.incorrect: Finish the attempt first; then reopen the old banks and repair one dimension at a time.
